newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Diablo Canyon nuke back at full power.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Diablo Canyon nuke back at full power.

text.p: Pacific Gas and Electric Co's 1,087 megawatt Diablo Canyon nuclear power unit 1 returned to full service overnight after reducing power for condenser cleaning, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Avila Beach, Calif. unit was operating at 100 percent as of early Tuesday morning, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Power output at the unit was reduced to about 50 percent of capacity over the weekend for the condenser cleaning.
The 1,073 megawatt Diablo Canyon unit 2 was also operating normally at 100 percent capacity as of early Tuesday, the NRC said.
